decisions.reason: As a complementary track-system accessory with likely low carrying cost, this option can be kept open because its value may still be realized without tying up much capital.
A standalone LED luminaire from 2018 faces strong competition and likely overlap with newer lighting launches, so after several years the information gained is sufficient to cut a weaker option.

A home automation server box is farther from the firm's core lighting hardware and typically needs ongoing support, so once uncertainty has largely resolved it is costly to keep a likely weak option alive.
A luminaire family suggests a broader platform in the firm's core business, and if retention costs are moderate it remains worth keeping as an option despite limited evidence.
